posts.title: A Database Backup Is Not a Restore Test
posts.summary: Test restoration on a schedule, verify application-level invariants afterward, and measure recovery time. A green backup job is not evidence of recoverability.

posts.title: The Quarantine Table Is Part of the Importer
posts.summary: Preserve rejected input with its reason, source position, and batch identity. Quarantine makes partial progress auditable and repairable.

posts.title: NOT NULL Cannot Tell You What a Field Means
posts.summary: A non-null database value is not a semantic contract. Name units, ownership, lifecycle, and interpretation at the boundary where data acquires meaning.
